name: Cap Node Traversal
aliases: Cap Node Traversal and Neighbor Finding
Gargantini and Atkinson Octree Traversal (Cap Node Variant)
definition: A specialized traversal routine for cap nodes, which are leaf-like structures containing scalar values, differing from interior nodes in how child values are retrieved.
summary: Cap Node Traversal efficiently retrieves voxel values and performs isosurface intersection for sparse voxel octree leaf structures, avoiding recursive descent overhead by using direct scalar retrieval and local neighbor finding.
